title: Equations of Motion
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly write the equations of motion for each particle in the system.

title: Angular Frequency
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive the correct expression for the angular frequency of rotation given the distance d.

title: Stability Condition
description: Important Criteria: The student must identify and explain the stability condition for the motion of mass m3 about the stationary position.

title: Force Direction
description: Important Criteria: The student should indicate that the forces acting on the particles are attractive and point towards the center of mass.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the derivations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes in the equations of motion.

title: Neglecting Masses
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should not neglect the contributions of m1 and m2 when analyzing the forces on m3.
